description:
We are urgently seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the nursing team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal role offers a competitive salary range of $85,000 - $95,000 per year, reflecting the importance of this leadership position. The ideal candidate will be instrumental in ensuring the highest standards of patient care and operational excellence.

This is an excellent opportunity for a compassionate leader to make a significant impact within a supportive environment. We are looking to fill this role quickly, so interested candidates are encouraged to apply promptly.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa
Minimum of 2-3 years of nursing leadership experience, preferably as a DON or ADON
Experience in a Skilled Nursing Facility (SNF) or long-term care setting
Strong knowledge of state and federal regulations
Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $85,000 to $95,000, based on experience and qualifications.

description: Join a dedicated team within a dynamic public school district in Westminster, CO, as a School Psychologist. This is an excellent contract opportunity offering a competitive rate of $60/hr or more, starting August 5, 2026, for a 43-week term. You will play a crucial role in supporting student success and well-being by conducting comprehensive psychoeducational evaluations and providing essential interventions.In this vital position, you will collaborate closely with students, parents, teachers, and administrators to foster a positive learning environment. Your expertise will be instrumental in interpreting assessment results, developing individualized education plans (IEPs), and implementing effective behavior intervention strategies. This role offers a chance to make a significant impact on the lives of students within a supportive educational setting.
requirements: Master's or Doctoral degree in School Psychology
Colorado Department of Education (CDE) Special Service Provider License - School Psychologist
Experience working with diverse student populations
Knowledge of federal and state special education laws
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation starts at $60 per hour for a 43-week contract, beginning August 5, 2026.
